title: Journey status
intro: Six journeys to monitor. Open a light to understand its steps.
error: The refresh failed. Retained observations need to be checked.
forbidden: Your account cannot view these observations.
expired: This observation has expired. Its current state is not verified.
scope: These lights use server observations and refresh while this page is visible. A correlated chain confirms recorded facts; it does not check the browser journey or email receipt. Test evidence is labelled separately.

evidence.correlated_records: Correlated business chain from server records.
evidence.partial_records: Partial observation of server records; the complete journey remains unverified.
evidence.authenticated_request: Authenticated administrative request observed; the complete sign-in remains unverified.
evidence.none: No recent evidence available for this step.

diagnostic.correlated_chain: The required steps belong to one recently observed business chain.
diagnostic.correlated_step: This step has a confirmed fact linked to the observed journey.
diagnostic.partial_observation: Some steps have been observed, but journey evidence is incomplete.
diagnostic.source_missing: A source needed for this observation is not configured or available.
diagnostic.source_unavailable: A required source could not be read.
diagnostic.processing_failed: A processing failure prevents this journey from completing.
diagnostic.processing_delayed: Processing is taking longer than expected and needs checking.
diagnostic.delivery_uncertain: A delivery outcome is uncertain. Verify the facts before retrying.
diagnostic.awaiting_review: An administrative review is pending; this expected wait does not indicate an outage.
diagnostic.awaiting_authorization: Administrative authorization is pending; this expected wait does not indicate an outage.
diagnostic.smtp_accepted: The email was accepted by the SMTP transport. Receipt is not confirmed.
diagnostic.public_observation_missing: The public display has not been checked; the available records cannot confirm it.
diagnostic.authenticated_request: The API accepted this request with a valid administrative session.
